question: If there's an episode with Garfiel and Petra, please tell me!
answer: When Petra is working on improving her cooking for Subaru's sake, Garfiel eats it cheerfully, so with him acting as her taste-tester, they're good friends. Garfiel understands that Petra loves Subaru, so they're the Unrequited Love Alliance, yes. Good friends, bound by good meat. Garf-san, you dummy!
